chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him)
About the Consultative Committee of Umar and the People of Jamal

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْجَمَلِ: The People of Jamal (participants in the Battle of the Camel)

ai.seo_question: What is the content of Imam Ali's sermon regarding Umar's consultative committee and the Battle of Jamal?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) discourse on the political legitimacy crisis following Umar’s death, where he contested the Shura council's selection process and the subsequent deviation from the Prophet’s designated succession. It sets the stage for the Battle of Jamal, framing the conflict not merely as a civil war but as a struggle to restore the true authority of the Ahl al-Bayt against the emerging Umayyad political structure.
